flows.title: Add a user
steps: Stop and tell the person, and change nothing, if Dext says the account has reached its plan's limit on users. Never change the plan, the user bundle or the number of users the plan allows to make room.
In the Dext web app, go to Users and select Add a user. Only Admins can add users; if Users is not in the sidebar, the person signed in does not have permission.
Enter the user's details and choose whether to give them login access, then select Next and choose a role for them.
Review and add any additional permissions if needed, and choose whether to send the invitation by email or by text message.
Select Add to send the invitation.
